screens.screen: incoming orders (open/closed badge, status tabs, order cards with accept / reject / ready actions, 5-tab bottom nav)
my store (cover + logo, store management tiles)
statistics (daily/weekly/monthly/yearly filter, orders and income cards)

notes: Same brand colours as the customer app. No font is bundled in this repo, so the app renders with the system font; drawn with the iOS system Arabic font (SF Arabic). Store cover and logo are network images, drawn as a gradient and an initial. The statistics screen is sparse in the real code too (two cards); it was kept because it is the merchant-specific screen. The action button for an accepted order is spelled 'تحظير' in the code (typo for 'تحضير'); the sample shows a pending order (قبول/رفض) and a cooking order (جاهز) instead. Dates use the app's own formats (timeago 'ar' and 'MMMM d, yyyy, h:mm a').
